 Rockstar Targets 2027 for GTA 6 Online Multiplayer Release
 Oliver Bennett 
 Published 
 Nov 20, 2026 - 18:23 
 48 
 Reads 
 Last Update 
 Nov 20, 2026 - 18:23 
 Share 
 WhatsApp 
 Photo by Rockstar Games. GTA 6 Online has no confirmed release date, with multiplayer expected in 2027. 
 Smallest Font 
 Largest Font 
 Rockstar Games is expected to introduce the multiplayer experience for Grand Theft Auto VI in 2027, potentially between March and June, following the game's single-player launch. However, as of November 20, 2026, the developer has not announced an official release date for GTA 6 Online or confirmed when players will be able to explore its online world together.
 GTA 6 is currently available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as a single-player experience. According to PlayStation's official FAQ, the game does not include multiplayer at launch. Rockstar's announcement also provided no confirmed schedule for the separate online mode.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 Industry reporting offers some indication of the anticipated timeline. Bloomberg journalist Jason Schreier reported in October that GTA 6 Online was expected to arrive in 2027. Meanwhile, Bank of America analysts have suggested a possible launch window between March and June 2027, following a meeting with Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick.

 GTA 6 Introduces Four Relationship Levels for Jason and Lucia 
 These projections do not represent an official announcement from Rockstar. The developer has yet to disclose the multiplayer release schedule or provide details about the features planned for the new online experience.
 Another possibility involves a gradual launch through public testing. Rockstar previously introduced Red Dead Online through a beta period before making the service fully available. A similar approach could allow GTA 6 players to access multiplayer before its complete release.
 Comments from Twitch CEO Dan Clancy have also attracted attention among the gaming community. During an interview with Bloomberg, Clancy discussed the potential return of GTA roleplay communities and described the activity as likely to be "reinvigorated" in January, February, and March.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Reveals Jason and Lucia Have a Son 
 However, Clancy subsequently clarified that he did not know when GTA 6's multiplayer mode would launch. His remarks therefore do not establish an official release window for the upcoming service.
 Meanwhile, players can continue using the existing GTA Online experience while waiting for the new installment. Take-Two Interactive confirmed earlier this month that Rockstar Games would continue supporting the current service with additional content and events.
 This means players can still explore Los Santos and participate in existing online activities while anticipation builds for the multiplayer world associated with GTA 6, which takes place in the fictional state of Leonida.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Revives Classic Characters and Changes Safehouse System 
 Rockstar's previous releases provide additional context for the possible rollout. GTA Online originally launched on October 1, 2013, just 14 days after Grand Theft Auto V arrived. Red Dead Online opened its beta to all owners on November 30, 2018, approximately 35 days after Red Dead Redemption 2 launched.
 Red Dead Online subsequently remained in beta until May 14, 2019, completing a 200-day period before its full release. These timelines demonstrate that Rockstar has previously used different approaches when introducing multiplayer experiences.
 However, both previous online services had been announced before their respective base games launched. Rockstar had confirmed GTA Online's release date in August 2013, while its Red Dead Online beta plans were also communicated before Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived.
 Also Read 
 CyberLeek Claims to Leak GTA 6 Xbox Development Build 
 Unlike those previous releases, Rockstar has not provided comparable advance confirmation for GTA 6 Online. The company has also not announced whether the new multiplayer service will begin with a beta, early access period, or immediate full release.
 For now, GTA 6 remains a single-player experience on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, while its separate multiplayer release remains unconfirmed.
